title: Mushroom Mince Spag Bol
subtitle: with Zucchini ‘Noodles’
description: You won't need a spiraliser to make these zucchini noodles (or zoodles if you want to be on trend with the lingo), a julienne peeler or even a veggie peeler will do. Serve with a meatless mushroom sauce and enjoy a healthy, vegan, low-carb dinner.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely chop the onion. Coarsely chop the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems, keeping them separate. Coarsely crumble the mushroom patties.

Start sauce: Heat 2 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the garlic, onion and parsley stems, stirring occasionally, for 3 mins or until softened. Increase the heat to high, add the crumbled mushroom patties and 1½ tsp barbecue seasoning and cook, stirring, for 1-2 mins until fragrant.

Simmer sauce: Add the diced tomatoes, 2 tbs tomato paste and ½ tsp chilli flakes, if using, to the pan. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 2 mins or until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Make zucchini noodles: Meanwhile, shred the zucchini using a julienne peeler. Or peel into long ribbons with a vegetable peeler, then, in batches, stack a few ribbons on top of each other and cut into thin noodles (see Kitchen hack).
Serve up: Divide the zucchini noodles and mushroom sauce among bowls. Scatter over the chopped parsley leaves and enjoy!

Kitchen hack: You can also use a spiraliser if you have one. If you prefer, you can even leave the zucchini ribbons whole, but you will need to mix them through the piping hot sauce to wilt slightly. It won't look exactly the same as the photo, but it will be just as delicious!
